propositions: Hardcoded `src/rebar` scan and `.github/module-size-limit.txt` file paths must be removed from git_metrics and registry in favor of config-driven scc LOC analyzer
Non-Python repos currently receive fabricated zero counts instead of honest Unavailable when size metrics are unavailable; this must be fixed by delegating to the analyzer

Registry-wired metrics must adapt via `_analyzer_spec(id, fn)` that calls `scc_loc.analyze(ctx.repo_root, ctx.scan_roots)` and passes the LOC payload to uniform 3-arg fns `(loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction)`
Context in `_commands/metrics.py` must be extended to carry `scan_roots`, `size_cap`, and `size_near_fraction` from `[code_health]` config
The `oversized_module_count` seed stub in registry.py must be removed so only the analyzer-derived spec remains; `module_size_trend` seed stays as Unavailable
Analyzer-derived metric specs must carry `source="structural"`, `lens="code_health"`, and `accruing_since="2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"` provenance; `cap_change_events` must be deregistered
